title: Godzilla - Domination!
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 1100006406 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Fighting. Widths of HP/score not stated in notes; read as u8 (may be wider). Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. PC mGBA sweep (boot, mash, walk; C2 gbaverify): player HP 72 falling to 28 and rival HP 72 -> 69 during a fight. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Up to four giant monsters fight in a city: smash buildings for power and knock rivals down.
widgets.label: How it plays

widgets.text: A punch, B kick, R grab/throw, L jump; special uses the energy meter
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: Godzilla and Toho rivals such as Mecha-King Ghidorah, Rodan, Megalon, Anguirus and Gigan.
widgets.label: Roster

widgets.text:
Throw buildings at rivals; collect power-ups from rubble.
Charge the special beam when the rival is down.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Destructible city stages; military forces attack everyone.
widgets.label: Stages

widgets.text: Health and energy pickups appear when buildings collapse.
widgets.label: Pickups

widgets.text: Win Adventure with monsters to unlock more of the roster.
widgets.label: Unlocks

widgets.text: Beat the series of fights in Adventure mode.
widgets.label: Goal
